meta.live_billing_rule: per turn, all tokens in the session context window are billed (system instruction + retained history, audio kept as audio tokens at the audio INPUT rate); transcription text billed at text OUTPUT rate; proactive audio bills input for all listening time (always on for gemini-3.8-live)
